decisions.statement: A note is written only where the row has no note.
The note written is read back from Monarch before that note is called written.
A row whose note ends in the order number has that number recorded though nothing was written.
The order number recorded is read back from the file before the write is called done.
A note Monarch respelled is reported as respelled rather than as unwritten.
A row already carrying the order number is not rewritten.
Nothing is written where the caller did not ask to write.
The writes are said where the caller did not ask to write.
Amazon rows are read from the first of January two thousand and twenty-five onward.

definition: the Amazon note written onto a transaction, and the order number kept beside it
